name: Zee Asadel
bio: Azizi Shafaa Asadel, known mononymously as Zee JKT48, is a rising Indonesian singer, actress, and member of the popular idol group JKT48. Born on May 16, 2004, in Jakarta, Indonesia, she comes from a family rooted in the entertainment industry, being the daughter of Fadli Akhmad and niece of Fadlan Muhammad, both known for their work in hosting and acting. Introduced as a seventh-generation member of JKT48 on September 29, 2018, Zee quickly climbed the ranks from Academy Class B to Class A, and eventually joined Team J in October 2019.

credits.overview: A dedicated young woman serving as her family's primary financial provider finds her matrimonial aspirations permanently derailed when she uncovers a debilitating secret: their ancestral home was pawned by her late father to finance her eldest brother's opulent wedding.

credits.overview: A thirteen-year-old boy battling severe chronic asthma refuses to abandon his ambitions of joining the Indonesian National Youth Football Team, finding an extraordinary path to athletic rehabilitation through the intervention of a mystical Garuda entity and the strategic support of the head coach's daughter.
